case.summary: Case HHG-017 was opened following a real-time risk alert on transaction 3450629 ($100.09), which identified an episode of three online transactions totaling $300.14 on card C04570-K1 on 2016-11-11. All transactions occurred between 22:36:50 and 23:46:24 for product R in region 204. Customer C04570 confirmed they did not perform the transactions while still holding physical possession of the card, confirming card-not-present fraud with a calibrated probability of 0.92. Card C04570-K1 was blocked and the case logged, with no SAR required due to the $300.14 exposure falling below the $1,000 reporting threshold.
